ALGER, [date] (APS) — La poste de Sidi Y: ALGIERS, [date] (APS) — The Sidi Yahya post office, located in the wilaya of Tlemcen, is undergoing expansion and modernization work. Postal services are temporarily transferred to the annexed commune of Sidi Mjahid until the work is completed.
Un bureau de poste temporaire a été ouve: A temporary post office was opened in the annexed commune of Sidi Mjahid to guarantee the continuity of services during the work. This operation is part of the national postal network modernization program.
La Poste algérienne précise que ces amén: The Algerian Post specifies that these developments aim to improve the reception conditions for customers and the quality of the services offered.
